name: Quotation
description: Business and client details, a clear pricing schedule, calculated totals, and optional terms and acceptance. For service and product quotations.
structure: A compact quotation heading, reference, issue date, and optional validity date introduce the same page as the pricing. An optional logo slot sits at the upper right.
Seller and client details sit side by side, followed by an optional scope introduction.
Line items flow in a table with repeating headers. Calculated totals align to the right beneath it.
Optional terms and acceptance follow the pricing. Each document owns its data; themes change the appearance and the layout stays adaptable.
